title: Discovering Explicit Magnetic Core-Loss Equations via Symbolic Sparse Identification
abstract: arXiv:2611.33364v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Compact core loss equations are essential tools in magnetic component design, but existing approaches trade accuracy against interpretability. Empirical models such as the Steinmetz Equation (SE) yield compact expressions of limited accuracy, while machine learning methods achieve high accuracy as black-box predictors. This paper bridges the gap with a Symbolic Sparse Identification (SSI) framework, which casts core loss modeling as a data-driven symbolic regression problem and recovers unknown equations directly from measured data, without presuming a functional form. First, a comprehensively expanded library of symbolic candidate terms far richer than the SE is constructed. Second, the governing terms are isolated from this library by sparse regression. Third, the coefficients of the retained terms are refined with an AdamW optimizer to maximize accuracy and form an analytical equation. Experiments on Fair-Rite 78, 79, and 95 yield tes

translated_title: 基于符号稀疏辨识的显式磁芯损耗方程发现方法
translated_abstract: 紧凑的磁芯损耗方程是磁性元件设计中的重要工具，但现有方法在精度与可解释性之间难以兼顾。诸如Steinmetz方程（SE）之类的经验模型虽然表达式紧凑，但精度有限；而机器学习方法虽能达到较高精度，却只能作为黑箱预测器使用。本文提出了一种符号稀疏辨识框架来弥合这一差距，该框架将磁芯损耗建模转化为数据驱动的符号回归问题，无需预设函数形式，即可直接从实测数据中恢复未知方程。首先，构建了一个远比SE丰富得多的、全面扩展的符号候选项库；其次，通过稀疏回归从该库中筛选出主导项；第三，利用AdamW优化器对保留项的系数进行精调，以最大化精度并形成解析方程。在Fair-Rite 78、79和95材料上的实验获得了（原文此处截断）……
tldr: 本文提出符号稀疏辨识（SSI）框架，无需预设函数形式即可直接从实测数据中发现显式、可解释且高精度的磁芯损耗方程，弥合了经验模型与机器学习黑箱方法之间的差距。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Symbolic Sparse Identification (SSI) framework that discovers explicit, interpretable, and accurate magnetic core-loss equations directly from measured data without presuming a functional form, bridging the gap between empirical models and black-box machine learning approaches.
